craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 46. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: On image, on pot-in-heap, on brick, on thread-then: should worship by
own, by own service; mixture should reject — thus.
